rule: Three passes, presentation only. Each pass ends at a human stop, after sparq_check_diff passes.
gate: Pass the working-tree diff (git diff, plus new files) to sparq_check_diff.
Revert every hunk it lists under revert, and record the intent as a suggestion in SPARQ_ADOPTION.md.
Justify or revert every line it lists under review.
Run the app's typecheck, tests, and build if the app has them. A failure stops the pass early.
Report the changed files, the reverted hunks, and the suggestions added. Then stop.

stages.title: Connect and plan
apply: Link cssUrl and fontsUrl from sparq_get_tokens once, in the document head or root layout. Do not copy the stylesheet into the app.
If not already done, add the Sparq MCP server and copy templates/consumer/AGENTS.md to the app root.
Write SPARQ_ADOPTION.md from sparq_plan_adoption, including the surface batches.
Do not point existing styles at the new variables yet.
suggest: Confirm the app looks the same as before the link. If it does not, the stylesheet is doing more than declaring variables.
stages.stop: Stop after the plan is written. The app should look unchanged.

stages.title: Foundation
apply: In the theme layer only, map background and text colors to Sparq variables. The theme layer is global CSS, root custom properties, or the theme config, such as a Tailwind theme or a CSS-in-JS theme object.
In the same layer, swap font families to the Sparq sans and mono stacks.
Do not edit component files in this pass. List colors and fonts hardcoded in components under their surface batch in SPARQ_ADOPTION.md.
Leave cards, radii, buttons, spacing, and copy as they are.
stages.stop: Stop after the gate passes. Every screen changes at once, so check a few screens.

stages.title: Surfaces
apply: Work on one batch from SPARQ_ADOPTION.md: related screens, such as one route or one feature area. Leave screens outside the batch alone.
Move the colors and fonts listed for this batch onto Sparq variables.
Replace card borders, card fills, and elevation shadows with 1px hairlines or space, following the hairline-or-space rule. Keep the same elements.

The view's one primary action uses the filled primary: --sparq-accent-deep fill and --sparq-ground text. Restyle other filled accent chrome as an accent hairline or text. Remove dashed borders. Each control stays the same control.
Add a visible focus style and a 24px hit area, using padding or min-size.
If a status word is already rendered, place a presentational orb beside it with data-orb, hidden from assistive tech.
suggest: Rebuilding tab order, roving tabindex, or live regions is behavior. Do not code it in this pass.
Do not invent a status, bind an orb to new state, or change when work starts and stops.
stages.stop: Stop after the gate passes for this batch. Do not start the next batch.
